content:
**Acidic Gulper Gland** is a junk item in *Fallout 76*.

The item is required to craft the Acidic Gulper Hand weapon mod for the Gulper Smacker. It can also be broken down into its individual components for use in crafting.

| Materials: | | Produces: | 
| Acidic Gulper Gland (1) | | Acid (2) |
